description: Fixed development set for the 1.2.1 offline English→Simplified Chinese sentence-translation work. Each item is a short English sentence authored for this repository together with a human-written Simplified Chinese reference used only to compare decoding variants. This is a DEVELOPMENT set, not an accuracy benchmark and not a held-out test set: the sentences were written while developing the decoding changes and must never be quoted as generalization accuracy. No third-party text and no private user text is included. Nothing from this file may be hard-coded into the application as an output override; the frozen OPUS-MT int8 model remains the only translation engine.
referenceNote: The Chinese 'reference' field is one acceptable human translation, not a unique gold answer. chrF against it measures closeness to that one wording, not correctness in general.

cases.source: Before the company signs the agreement, the legal department must review every clause, confirm that the payment schedule matches the approved budget, verify that the insurance requirements are acceptable, and check whether the termination provisions allow either party to withdraw without a penalty during the first year, because the board will not approve a contract that could expose the organization to unexpected liabilities or make it impossible to change suppliers if the service quality declines.
